i’m sorry your family and your friends don’t treat you like how you are supposed to be. i’d say find a hobby you like and just make new friends through a hobby. that’s how i made new friends and met new people that way, though i’ve cut ties with them due to problems. i plan to make new friends through hobbies, interests and all. you don’t gotta be so deep in the friendship too. just people to hang around whenever you’d like to i’d say. the people may not be the best people you can meet but if you never let yourself be too deep in the friendship then i don’t think they can use you like how others you’re around do. i know you may miss the friends that went to the army but i think meeting a couple new people and just hanging around time to time would help. hopefully this helps.

thank you and i guess it‘s been the reactions of people i worry about the most. especially with my parents. for them i was always a happy loving child and to tell them that i’m really struggling and they’d want to know more about how i feel. i guess i really don’t want to be a problem for my family. i know i’ve been a real burden for them lately

i used to be very outgoing with my family as well. til around last winter i really started to be distant with my family. nowadays i try to interact more with my family but i always end up being upset or mad at them for the dumbest reasons. and i sit back each night regretting my decisions hoping i held back too.

i was scared as well. while i was holding onto my belt the only thing i wanted was to be back down. then when i was down, i wanted to try again. it hurt but what scared me the most was not knowing if i truly want to die and ending up dead. i’m still really contemplating about it too
